reports.title: Robyn Skilton: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: we are working nationally to support local areas to expand mental health services so that more people can access the care and support they need.
promises.summary: Expand mental health services to increase access for children and young people.

concerns.quote: Robyn was failed by the Mental Health Services quite frankly due to the current lack of resourcing and provision in place to support young people struggling with their mental health
concerns.hazard: lack of resourcing and provision of mental health services for young people

concerns.quote: Robyn initial acceptance into tier 3 Children and Mental Health Services (CAMHS) similarly did not happen in a timely manner

Referrals to West Sussex CAMHS have increased by 95.6% from May 2019 (389) to May 2022 (761) West Sussex CAMHS caseload has increased by 85% from May 2019 (2239) to May 2022 (4147) West Sussex CAMHS Duty caseload has increased by 112% from May 2021 (492) to May 2022 (1494) Mental
concerns.hazard: unsustainable demand on CAMHS without increased resources

reports.title: Allison Aules: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: We are developing a business case to secure additional funding to support improved resourcing of CAMHS services within NELFT.
promises.summary: Develop business case for additional CAMHS funding and seven-day working.

promises.quote: The business case will also include requirements to implement a face to face approach for initial CAMHS assessments.

Recruitment of consultant psychiatrists is a national issue which we recognise locally - NHS North East London is working with NELFT and other providers to support recruitment and looking at innovative ways of recruiting. This work is being led by our Chief People and Culture Officer,
promises.summary: Support recruitment of consultant psychiatrists via partnership and innovation.

promises.quote: In the short term for CAHMS for NELFT we have developed a business case for more funding to support this demand.
promises.summary: Develop business case for additional CAMHS funding to meet demand.

promises.quote: The Trust is determined to ensure that all patients receive care in a person-centred approach and that the patient's voice is at the centre of planning the patient's care. The Trust's expectation is that the young person's voice is heard in the triage, initial assessment, care/treatment plan, and follow-ups alongside their parents / responsible adults.
promises.summary: Implement monthly supervision and audits to capture patient voice

concerns.quote: The Inquest identified multiple failings in the care provided to Allison
The Inquest heard evidence that the under resourcing of CAMHS services is not confined to this local Trust but is a matter of National concern
The Inquest heard that funding for CAMHS teams within the allocation of funding for general mental health is poor
The Inquest heard that the number of children presenting to CAMHS teams is increasing significantly
The Inquest heard of the difficulties in recruiting suitably qualified psychiatrists to CAMHS teams
concerns.hazard: shortage of qualified psychiatrists in CAMHS

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that child and adolescent mental health services (CAMHS) are inadequately resourced despite rising demand, creating risks to young people.
links.earlier_quote: Despite the increase in numbers accessing CAMHS there has not been any relative increase in resources to meet this demand and therefore the current position is is unsustainable and it is putting many young people's lives at risk.
links.later_quote: The Inquest heard that the number of children presenting to CAMHS teams is increasing significantly.
